statement: The function returns a result r and r = min_{v in V} max_{0 <= i < n} min_{0 <= j < n, nums[j]=v} cdist(i,j), where n = len(nums), V is the set of integers v for which there exists j with 0 <= j < n and nums[j]=v, and cdist(a,b) = min(((b-a) mod n), ((a-b) mod n)) with x mod n the least nonnegative residue in [0,n-1]. The outer minimum is over the nonempty finite set V, and each inner minimum is over the nonempty set of indices j with nums[j]=v.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1, len(nums) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r (that is, it does not fail, panic, or return an error) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1, len(nums) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and 0 <= r <= floor(len(nums)/2).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1, len(nums) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 0 if and only if for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] = nums[0].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1, len(nums) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 0 if nums[0] = nums[1], and r = 1 if nums[0] != nums[1].
preconditions: len(nums) = 2, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 1.
preconditions: len(nums) is even, len(nums) >= 2, len(nums) <= 100000, and there exist distinct integers a and b such that for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), nums[i] = a when i is even and nums[i] = b when i is odd.

statement: The function returns a result r and there exists an index j with 0 <= j < len(nums) such that r = max_{0 <= i < n} min_{0 <= k < n, nums[k]=nums[j]} cdist(i,k), where n = len(nums) and cdist(a,b) = min(((b-a) mod n), ((a-b) mod n)) with x mod n the least nonnegative residue in [0,n-1].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1, len(nums) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: The function returns a result r and for every index j with 0 <= j < len(nums), r <= max_{0 <= i < n} min_{0 <= k < n, nums[k]=nums[j]} cdist(i,k), where n = len(nums) and cdist(a,b) = min(((b-a) mod n), ((a-b) mod n)) with x mod n the least nonnegative residue in [0,n-1].
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1, len(nums) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Let fmax be the maximum, over all integers v, of the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v. The function returns a result r and r <= floor((len(nums) - fmax + 1)/2).
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1, len(nums) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Let fmax be the maximum, over all integers v, of the number of indices i with 0 <= i < len(nums) and nums[i] = v. The function returns a result r and r >= floor(ceil(len(nums)/fmax)/2), where ceil(x/y) = (x + y - 1)/y for positive integers x and y.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1, len(nums) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: For every integer k, let nums' be the slice of length len(nums) defined by nums'[i] = nums[(i+k) mod len(nums)] for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums). Whenever minimum_seconds(nums) returns r and minimum_seconds(nums') returns r', we have r' = r.
preconditions: len(nums) >= 1, len(nums) <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 1000000000.

statement: Whenever minimum_seconds(nums) returns r and minimum_seconds(nums') returns r', we have r' = r.
preconditions: nums and nums' are slices of the same length n with n >= 1, n <= 100000, and for every i with 0 <= i < n, both nums[i] and nums'[i] lie in [1, 1000000000]. Moreover, for every i and j with 0 <= i < n and 0 <= j < n, nums[i] = nums[j] if and only if nums'[i] = nums'[j].
